title: Spanish Berry Paella
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Spanish-inspired paella dish filled with juicy berries. Perfect for a light and healthy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the Spanish rice and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the mixed berries and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Let paella rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
